uni.intro: Academic partners connect to the competency framework and the talent pipeline. Every partner listed here has a public source.

ku.title: Nuclear engineering degrees
ku.body: MSc in Nuclear Engineering since 2010, aimed at careers at FANR, ENEC and ENEC Operations; a PhD in Engineering with a nuclear concentration since 2012; and a BSc nuclear minor.
ku.source: Khalifa University · MSc in Nuclear Engineering

entc.title: Emirates Nuclear Technology Center
entc.body: Launched in November 2019 with ENEC and FANR. Works on nuclear safety, materials and chemistry, and radiation safety.

ep.title: Energy Pioneers
ep.body: Since 2009, "over 500 UAE Nationals benefitted". Partner universities in the UAE, the United States (Penn State, Texas A&M, NC State) and Korea.

nitss.title: Nuclear Innovation & Technology Summer School
nitss.body: The 2024 summer school had 60 participants from 20 universities.
nitss.source: UAE National Report, 10th CNS Review Meeting

iat.title: Technical school routes
iat.body: The Institute of Applied Technology feeds the technician pipeline. Abu Dhabi Polytechnic ran the former Higher Diploma in Nuclear Technology, which the Diploma in Nuclear Technology replaced in 2023.
iat.source: UAE National Report, 10th CNS Review Meeting

src.title: Saskatchewan Research Council and GIEMS
src.body: A January 2026 memorandum of understanding on small modular reactors, AI and robotics, waste and capacity building. MoUs are non-binding evaluations.

uni.partnersHint: Filter by type or country. Relationships are listed only where a public source exists.
uni.digestNote: Entries marked "search digest only" come from secondary summaries and are kept until a primary source is found.
uni.internshipsHint: Placements ENEC publishes for university students. Applications are made through the internships programme.
uni.internshipsApply: How to apply for an internship
uni.alignHint: Choose the roles your graduates target to see and export the competencies and levels they need.
uni.joinRule1: The university workspace shows only students who have consented to share their progress with that university.
uni.joinRule2: Sponsors see individual scholar progress; universities see consenting students and cohort totals only.
uni.joinRule3: Research proposals are screened for security sensitivity and export control before any public mention.
uni.consentBody: Students decide whether their university can see their progress, and can withdraw that consent at any time.

curr.title: Competencies for target roles
curr.intro: Pick one or more roles. The table lists every competency those roles need, the highest required proficiency level and whether it is core.
curr.note: Security, safeguards and cyber roles are not listed here: they show the career path only.

ip.moet: Refer inventions to the MoET patents route (May 2026)
ip.source: ENEC and the Ministry of Economy and Tourism: IP agreement (May 2026)

res.intro: Curated public problem statements. Researchers respond with a proposal; inventions are referred to the patents route agreed with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism in May 2026.
res.screenBody: A challenge is published only after a screening sign-off for security sensitivity and export control, recorded in the audit log. Research data about the plant never goes on public pages.
res.partnersOnly: Proposals come from partner organisations and universities.
res.signInPartner: Sign in as a partner to propose
res.rule1: Do not include plant data, security-sensitive information or export-controlled content in a proposal.
res.rule2: Each proposal is screened before it is accepted or mentioned publicly.
res.rule3: Partners see only their own organisation's proposals.
res.ipBody: Where a proposal may lead to an invention, it is referred to the patents route that ENEC agreed with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism.

pu.intro: Your university's internship placements, consenting scholars, cohort totals and curriculum alignment.
pu.consentBody: A student appears here only if they consented to share their progress with your university. Students who have not consented are not shown, not counted and not hinted at.
pu.noOrg: Your organisation could not be loaded.
pu.noOnboarding: No onboarding case is recorded for your organisation.
pu.onboardingNote: Onboarding is handled by ENEC's partnerships team; the status here is read-only.
pu.noCohorts: No cohorts are recorded at your university.
pu.noScholarsBody: No student has consented to share their progress with your university yet.
pu.scholarsNote: Scholars are identified by reference only. Progress notes and grades stay with the sponsor.
pu.internshipsHint: Placements reserved for your university and placements open to any university.
pu.internshipsNote: Students apply through the internships programme; ENEC HR screens every application.

pr.intro: Respond to a published challenge or propose open research. Proposals are screened for security sensitivity and export control before any decision or public mention.
pr.safeBody: Do not include plant data, security arrangements, export-controlled technical data or personal data. Screening will decline any proposal that does.
pr.mineHint: Only your organisation can see these. Drafts can be edited; submitted proposals are locked.
pr.title: Title
pr.ipHint: Choose the patents route if the work may lead to an invention.
pr.challengesHint: Each challenge has passed a screening sign-off.
pr.stepsNote: ENEC's research screening authority checks security sensitivity and export control, routes IP, then accepts or declines.
pr.confirmBody: The proposal is locked and sent for security and export-control screening. ENEC records the decision; you will see it here.

ar.intro: Curate research challenges, sign off screening and decide proposals. Every action is recorded in the audit log.
ar.ruleBody: A challenge is public only when both the security-sensitivity and export-control checks are signed. Editing a published challenge takes it off the public page until it is screened again.
ar.readOnly: Read-only view: only the research screening authority acts here.
ar.themeHint: For example: Learning, Environment, Health & safety.
ar.editWarning: Saving changes takes this challenge off the public page until a new screening sign-off.
ar.securityHint: No plant security arrangements, plant data or clearance-related content.
ar.exportHint: No controlled technology or technical data.
ar.willPublish: Both checks signed: the challenge will be published.
ar.wontPublish: Not both checks signed: the result is recorded and the challenge stays unpublished.

decideBody.screening: "{title}" moves to screening. The partner sees the new status.
decideBody.accepted: "{title}" is accepted. Acceptance needs a completed security and export-control screening.
decideBody.declined: "{title}" is declined. The partner sees the decision.

ar.proposalScreen: Screened: no security-sensitive or export-controlled content
ar.proposalScreenHint: Required before a proposal can be accepted.
ar.auditHint: Every research action, including refusals, from the append-only audit log.
